recentItems.title: Utah Gov. Spencer Cox says government needs to "protect the public" on AI
recentItems.description:
Utah's Republican Gov. Spencer Cox told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that the government needs to come together to "protect the public" on AI, saying "government doesn't get this right often either, but we should be at the table working together, and that's what we've done in Utah."

recentItems.title: Admiral Brad Cooper says he's "not concerned at all" about munition shortage
recentItems.description:
"60 Minutes" correspondent Norah O'Donnell spoke to Admiral Brad Cooper, the commander in charge of the war in Iran. He told O'Donnell "I'm not concerned at all" about a munitions shortage to defend against Iranian missile and drone attacks. Watch the full interview on "60 Minutes" on CBS or Paramount+ this Sunday, Sept. 13 at 7:30 p.m. ET.
